verdict.rationale: Stripe documents no-code Payment Links you can share immediately and a prebuilt Stripe-hosted Checkout page for accepting card payments. A hands-on user report says they were accepting payments in under an hour, which supports same-day acceptance. One user was denied an account because of a non-US bank setup, but that is an eligibility edge case, not a contradiction of the core capability. missing for 10: first-party documentation of account activation/verification timelines for going live, recent independent corroboration of time-to-first-live-payment, and clarity on eligibility constraints that can block signup.
